Confluent.Kafka serializers and deserializers for AWS Glue Schema Registry on AvroSharp.Aws.Glue, in AWS's wire format, for Amazon MSK or any Kafka broker. Fully managed, no Apache.Avro.

An Azure Schema Registry serializer on AvroSharp for Event Hubs and Service Bus messages (MessageContent): generated and [AvroSerializable] types and generic records, with the content type and bytes of Microsoft's Avro serializer. No Apache.Avro.

Confluent Schema Registry serializers and deserializers for Confluent.Kafka on AvroSharp: generated types, your own [AvroSerializable] types, generic records and primitives, with the registry's framing, subject name strategies, references and rules. No Apache.Avro.

KafkaFlow serializers and deserializers for Confluent Schema Registry on AvroSharp: generated and [AvroSerializable] types, several types per topic, the same bytes as KafkaFlow's Confluent Avro serializer. No Apache.Avro.
